Our research group at the University Medical Center Göttingen (UMG) specializes in immunometabolism, with a particular focus on how viral infections and the tumor microenvironment orchestrate T cell response at the metabolic level. Funding for this position is provided by the “UMG2032 - Excellence through Focus” project, funded by zukunft.niedersachsen, the joint science funding program of the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture and the Volkswagen Foundation.

Your tasks

• Conduct an independent research project within a collaborative team
• Analyzing T cell biology via optogenetic tools.
• Investigating the regulatory mechanisms of ion channels in T cells.
• Supervision of students.
• Present and communicate research results at national and international scientific meetings.

Your qualifications

• You are a curious and enthusiastic scientist who can work independently but also in a team.
• Applicants should hold a PhD in the life sciences, such as immunology or a related subject.
• Strong background in T cell biology.
• Experience with CRISPR/Cas9 and retro/lentiviral systems for gene knock out and overexpression in primary cells.
• Prior experience in conducting animal experiments (mouse models).
• Proficiency in single-cell data analysis.
• Metabolomics/metabolic profiling is a strong advantage.
• A strong track record of publications in peer-reviewed international journals and a strong driving ambition for an academic career.
• Excellent English language skills (written and spoken) are required.

We offer

• You will work in a high-impact research field with biomedical relevance embedded in the collaborative environment of the Göttingen Campus including several supportive facilities and inspiring research consortia.
• Small, international and diverse research group with a strong team spirit and an open-minded, collaborative and respectful working atmosphere.
• The UMG is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.
• We further strive for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.

We are looking forward to receive your applications including a motivation letter, a CV, certificates and contact details for at least two references compiled as a single PDF via the system. If you have any questions regarding the advertised position, do not hesitate to contact Hao Wu (Email: hao.wu@med.uni-goettingen.de) for further information.

About us

The research group of Dr. Hao Wu at the Department of Gastroenterology, Gastrointestinal Oncology and Endocrinology, University Medical Center Göttingen, Göttingen, Germany is inviting applications for a Postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) Metabolic regulation of T cell response in chronic infection and tumor microenvironment.

About Allianz Global Investors

Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.

We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.

Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.

Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.

To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.

Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our ZEROe team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Masterand student (d/f/m), title of thesis: Virtual Sensor & State Estimation Development for Fuel Cell Systems

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know about the development of virtual sensors and advanced state estimation techniques for fuel cell systems? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the ZEROe team as Masterand (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration: 6 months

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Conduct a comprehensive literature review on virtual sensing, state estimation, and model-based diagnostics for fuel cell systems.
- Develop and implement models for fuel cell system components relevant to virtual sensing (e.g., degradation, performance).
- Design and evaluate virtual sensor algorithms to infer unmeasured system states and parameters.
- Implement and validate state estimation techniques (e.g., Kalman filters, Extended Kalman Filters, particle filters) for fuel cell systems.
- Utilize simulation environments (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python) for model development, algorithm testing, and data analysis.
- Analyze the performance and robustness of developed virtual sensors and state estimators under various operating conditions and fault scenarios.
- Document research findings, methodology, and results in a comprehensive Master's thesis.
- Present progress and results to the Airbus ZEROe team regularly.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time Master's student in the area of Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or a related field.
- Strong academic background in control theory, system identification, estimation theory, and data analysis.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python.
- Familiarity with fuel cell technologies and their operation principles is a plus.
- Experience with model-based development and simulation tools is desirable.
- Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and solve complex problems.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus.
- Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

As part of the “Potenziale strategisch entfalten” initiative within zukunft.niedersachsen, a joint funding program of the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture and the Volkswagen Foundation, University Medical Center Göttingen (UMG) is receiving almost €20 million to further strengthen its research and innovation activities. The UMG2032 – Excellence through Focus project focuses on recruiting and establishing early-career research groups, as well as early-career postdoctoral positions. Moreover, the project supports measures to promote knowledge transfer, graduate training for medical students, the establishment of a Medical Career Center, and further specialization in securing funding from international third-party funding agencies.

The Research Management team of the UMG oversees all EU-funded and international research projects, providing comprehensive support from advising applicants and handling contract negotiations to monitoring approved projects. Additionally, we assist with applications for national grants. As part of our commitment to expanding UMG’s success in securing international funding, we are placing a particular focus on opportunities from the US and UK. To achieve this, we are creating a specialized position within our team to provide targeted support to UMG scientists, covering both the application process and project administration.

We are seeking an open-minded, native English-speaking professional to step into this exciting and impactful role.

Your Tasks

Providing independent advice and support to researchers throughout the application and management process for third-party-funded research projects, with a particular emphasis on complex international funding opportunities. This includes navigating the specific regulatory and legal frameworks of international funding bodies, thereby enhancing our capacity to secure international grants. Key responsibilities include:

- Analysis and assessment of application and funding requirements, with a focus on understanding and interpreting the intricate regulatory and legal frameworks essential for successfully securing and implementing projects funded by international bodies.
- Providing guidance and support to researchers in the preparation, design, and drafting of third-party funding applications, ensuring compliance with the specific requirements of the funding call (e.g., budgetary considerations, formalities, and alignment of project proposals with the objectives of the call).
- Conducting formal and substantive reviews of third-party funding applications to ensure compliance with both internal and external guidelines, and coordinating additional administrative processes in collaboration with relevant UMG administrative departments.
- Providing support for ongoing internationally funded projects, including tasks such as contract negotiations and preparation, amendment requests, compliance monitoring, and financial or scientific reporting. Support for ongoing internationally projects (e.g. contract preparations, amendment requests, reporting)
- Offering target-group-specific information and organizing events or workshops on international research funding opportunities and best practices.
- Contributing to the strategic development of the Research Management Office, including identifying and addressing key challenges in handling complex international funding schemes and increasing UMG's competitiveness in securing international grants.

This role requires a deep understanding of the regulatory, legal and administrative landscape of international funders, with a focus on translating these complexities into actionable guidance and strategic opportunities for our researchers. By bridging the gap between funding bodies requirements and researchers needs, you will play a key role in expanding UMG’s potential to successfully acquire and manage international research grants.

To support your success in this role, we highly encourage further professional development, including certification as a Research Administrator (e.g., through the Research Administrators Certification Council), to deepen your expertise in international grant management and funding processes.

Your qualifications

- A completed academic degree (Master’s or equivalent)
- Experience in academic management or in the administration of third-party-funded collaborative projects is an advantage
- Strong knowledge of international funding landscape, particularly in the US or UK, ideally supported by certified further training (e.g. Certified Pre-Award Administrator (CPRA®) or Research   Admin (CPA®))
- Basic understanding of interdisciplinary topics relevant to grant applications, such as research data management, open science, diversity/equality and the promotion of early-career researchers
- Effective communication skills in German, written and spoken (minimum B1 level)
- A high level of initiative, organizational skills and reliability under time pressure, combined with strong teamwork and flexibility

We offer

- Good working conditions within a dedicated and motivated team
- A varied role in an international environment
- Health and fitness supported by an excellent workplace health management program
- A comprehensive range of training and development opportunities (see also above)
- Remuneration in accordance with the collective agreement for the public sector in the federal states (TV-L), including public sector social benefits and supplementary pension provision

Application deadline is Sunday, 18th October 2026 before the end of the day. Informal inquires can be directed to Dr. Uschi Hübner (forschung@med.uni-goettingen.de), Head of Research Management.

Data Analyst (all genders)

At Nect, we make digitalization tangible and secure. We develop AI- and biometrics-based trust services, including digital identity and signature solutions. Sounds technical? It is - but, more importantly, it’s exciting. Our technologies help public authorities and businesses prepare for the digital future. We are driven by our desire to demonstrate the simplicity and security of digital solutions while creating new opportunities for all. Are you ready to help shape the digital world of tomorrow with us?

About the role:

Decisions are only as good as the information they are based on. We are looking for a self-driven Data Analyst to provide the answers to business and product questions from our data. You will be part of the new Data and Insights team, together with a Data Engineer to bring our business insights to the Nect level. Your job is to make sure the KPI we look at are meaningful and correct, as well as to support Product and Business functions with insights for key decisions.

We will be more than happy to start a conversation with you!

- Build, maintain, and automate a modern presentation layer with live dashboards and periodic reports

- Identify and fulfill data needs for the organization through actionable data and visualizations
- Work closely with our Data Engineer to ensure our insights scale with our ambitions

You bring with you:

- Deep knowledge about best practices in KPI design and data visualization
- Excellent SQL and Python skills
- Familiarity with common BI tools and their capabilities and limitations
- Organization and prioritization skills
- Fluent in English and German

What we offer you:

- Flexible working hours & 40% remote working
- Scale-up culture with security and vision: digital, innovative, ambitious
- Flat hierarchies and quick decisions: real scope for your ideas
- Personal development: in a growing tech company with a future
- Modern office in Hamburg: central location between the Elbe and Alster rivers with a pleasant working atmosphere

Ready to help shape digital identity in Europe?

Job DescriptionHVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (m/f/d)

GE Vernova is facing a momentum of hypergrowth, and we are currently scaling up our teams, creating others from scratch, and bringing our industry to the next level. Join us on this mission!

At GE Vernova Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Vernova Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral.

Due to the growth of our HVDC business, we are currently looking for our next HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor in the “Construction & Commissioning” function to participate in this energy transition.

Your Mission: Within our large scale HVDC Projects you are responsible for the Supervision of the Installation for our HVDC Valves including the Valve Cooling System. The installation will be done by subcontractors.

This position implies functional leadership as an IC (Individual Contributor) without direct reports. It is a Construction Site based role.

Join us and enjoy playing a major role to enhance the Central Europe Construction & Commissioning function with fresh ideas!

Why we come to work:

At GE Vernova, our employees are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
Main Tasks/Responsibilities:

1. EHS
Ensure all installation activities are performed in accordance with safety protocols and regulatory requirements.
2. Quality Oversight
Implement quality control measures to ensure the reliability and performance of installed HVDC Valves & HVDC Primary Equipment.
Conduct inspections based on ITPs to verify adherence to quality standards.
Prepare and review installation documentation, test reports, and as-built drawings.
Ensure all tools, equipment, and materials are properly maintained and stored
3. Planning & Coordination
Coordinate the HVDC Primary Equipment & Valve installation activities with the Site Management Team and other internal and external stakeholders (Installation Subcontractor) on site.
Providing guidance, training and support as needed to the installation subcontractor
Coordinate with our internal Valve manufacturing to assure needed documentation is used at site during execution
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues that arise during the installation process
Technical education, preferably with a degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience in electrical- or mechanical installation works in large scale projects with at least 3 years experience in the relevant field.
Experience from Supervision or Site Management in substation, FACTS or HVDC Projects preferred.
Strong health and safety mindset aligned with international standards, with the ability to identify and stop unsafe work.
Strong interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to provide clear verbal and written reporting (English required).
Proactive mindset with the ability to recommend and approve corrective actions.
Professional Growth: Dynamic team, extensive resources, and training for skill development
A Booming industry with Cutting-Edge Projects: Involvement in high-profile, innovative projects
Global Exposure: Collaboration with a diverse, global network of industry experts
Collaborative Environment: Supportive culture fostering creativity and teamwork
A macro-management cultur...
